chunks: Ali (ibn al-Hakam) from Muhammad ibn Isa from Yunus from Al-ala' ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) regarding the man upon whom and his wife falls a house.

He (peace be upon him) said: The woman inherits from the man, and the man inherits from the woman. Its meaning is that they inherit from each other from the origins of their wealth; they do not inherit from what they have inherited from each other anything.
ai.seo_question: How do husband and wife inherit from each other if they die at the same time?
ai.summary: This narration from Imam al-Sadiq (AS) clarifies the mechanism of simultaneous death inheritance, distinguishing between inheriting from one's own acquired wealth versus the portion already inherited from the spouse. This distinction prevents circular inheritance loops and aligns with the Shia jurisprudential principle that the estate is divided based on the specific source of the wealth at the moment of death. It highlights the precision of Imami fiqh in handling complex succession scenarios where the order of death cannot be determined.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Yunus, from Al A’ala Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Muslim, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> regard the mam, a house collapsed upon him and his wife.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The woman would inherit from the man, and the man would inherit from the woman. Its meaning is, they would inherit each other from the origins of their wealth, they would not be inheriting anything from what they would have (already) inherited from each other’.
en.sarwar: 5. Ali has narrated from Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Yunus from al-‘Ala’ ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Muslim who has narrated the following: “About the case of a man and a woman on whom a house falls, abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The woman inherits from the man and the man inherits from the woman, which means that they inherit from the original of each other’s assets and not from what they inherit from each other.’”
